description.narrative: Outcomelevel indicator for the EFSD Investment Window on Digital (Cross sector indicator 4 Direct employment). Number of fulltime equivalent employees as per local definition working for the client company or project at the end of the reporting period.

comment.narrative: The 5th Quarterly Progress Report of the intervention covering period up to 31 March 2022 under Section 3.5 on pages 14 and 15 indicates that the construction works for substation and wind turbine are ongoing. The commissioning of substation is expected from 6 November 2022 while for the WTG it is supposed to start from 24 April 2023. Therefore there has been no employments with respect to OM as of yet and the current value can be considered as 0.
